Maya: Quick idea  mini food crawl? taco truck > gelato > rooftop mocktails. Afternoon-ish next Wednesday? :taco: :ice_cream: :tropical_drink:
Liam: I'm game. can we do 5pm start? it's better before rush hour.
Priya: love this. can we make one stop vegan-friendly? bringing a friend who doesn't eat dairy.
Noah: I'll scope vegan-friendly gelato place near the truck. also can bring some card games for rooftop.
Ellen: rooftop has limited space  need headcount for building pass.
Maya: ok let's cap at 8 people. whos in?
Liam: in
Priya: in (plus one)
Noah: in
Ellen: in
Maya: awesome. OpsBot can you make a quick RSVP?
OpsBot: RSVP poll: "Food crawl RSVP" Options: Yes (attending), Maybe, Not attending. Link: https://ops.example/polls/foodcrawl
Priya: note: i can pick up my guest if needed.
Liam: budget? $20 each?
Maya: yep $20 should be fine. we'll split rooftop fee if any.
Noah: found vegan gelato at "Happy Cone" 6 blocks from taco truck. they do coconut milk bases.
Ellen: I'm adding this to the building events board. Maya pls DM me with final names for passes.
Maya: will do. thanks team! :sparkles:
